title: Foundations of von Neumann algebras
description: Build Hilbert-space representations from positive functionals, compare norm and operator closures, and classify commutative and finite-dimensional approximation models. The course includes complete functional and complex analysis prerequisites, C*-algebra calculus and quotients, normal duality, projection types, dilation, state decompositions and measurable selection tools.
